name: 90222 · Compton, CA
findings: ZIP 90222 (Compton) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 4 of them (7%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
